hero.scope: Original generated website concept artwork, not gameplay evidence

outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished cinematic survival-scifi website hero artwork, standalone wide 16:9 landscape image, preferably 2048x1152.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are subject-design references of the SAME Tin Finch TF01 salvage orbital skiff, respectively front and engine-bay views. Reconstruct this unmistakable design with high fidelity in a new scene.
Primary request: Tin Finch parked in the RIGHT HALF of a rugged frontier landing clearing amid tall dry grass and scrap. A small corrugated-metal salvage shelter stands behind it; a pine ridge and distant industrial structures recede through the atmosphere.
Subject invariants: squat compact single-seat patched faded blue and cream boxy pressure cab, wide angular windshield with center divider, twin round front lamps, substantial red rust and flaking paint, black exposed pipes, red external fuel drum, exactly three cylindrical rear engines with nozzle bells, braced tubular landing skids; no wings. Keep the utilitarian vehicle size, silhouette, cab proportions and exposed mechanical engine assembly recognizable. View from its front three-quarter side to clearly show cab, windshield, one side of engine assembly, and landing skids.
Style/medium: premium original cinematic game key art with grounded realistic hard-surface detail, survival-game tactile materials and natural environmental scale, painterly cinematic polish with convincing photographic lighting; handsome rugged ship, no cartoon.
Composition: cinematic wide 16:9 frame; ship fully framed in right half; LEFT 40% must be dark, visually quiet environmental negative space intended for a large white headline added later, with no busy objects or highlights there. Natural landscape continues across the entire frame. No graphic gradient panels.
Lighting/mood: dramatic warm late-afternoon sunlight breaking through an overcast atmosphere, warm rim light picking out rusty ship edges, moody charcoal pine shadows and earthy grass, restrained atmospheric depth.
Constraints: generate one finished image only. No people, text, lettering, logos, watermark, UI, web design, interface elements or typography. Remove reference decals/lettering while preserving patches and worn panel texture. No sleek fighter, wings, enormous spaceship, beach, lush vacation coast, tropical colors or glossy futuristic plastic.
